verse.verse_5: The sun and the moon move according to a fixed reckoning;
verse.verse_6: the stars and the trees bend in prostration.
verse.verse_7: He raised the heavens and set up the measure,
verse.verse_8: so that you should not transgress the measure.
verse.verse_9: Always measure with justice and do not give short measure.
verse.verse_10: He has laid out the earth for His creatures.
verse.verse_11: On it are fruits and palm-trees with sheathed clusters [of dates],
verse.verse_12: and grains with their husk and fragrant plants.
verse.verse_13: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_14: He has created man, from dry ringing clay, like the potter"s,
verse.verse_15: and He created the jinns from a flame of fire.
verse.verse_16: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_17: He is the Lord of the two easts and the Lord of the two wests.
verse.verse_18: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_19: He has set the two oceans in motion, converging together.
verse.verse_20: Between them is a barrier, which they do not overrun.
verse.verse_21: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_22: Pearls and corals come forth from both of them.
verse.verse_23: Which, of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_24: His are the lofty ships, that rear aloft on the sea like mountains.
verse.verse_25: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_26: All that is on the earth is doomed to perish,
verse.verse_27: while your Lord's own Self will remain full of majesty and glory.
verse.verse_28: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_29: Everyone in the heavens and on the earth entreats Him. Every day He manifests Himself in a new state.
verse.verse_30: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_31: Soon We shall attend to you -- two big groups [of jinn and mankind].
verse.verse_32: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_33: O company of jinn and men! If you have the power to go beyond the realms of the heavens and the earth, pass beyond them: you cannot pass out but with [Our] authority.
verse.verse_34: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_35: Flames of fire and molten brass shall be sent against both of you, and you will not be able to defend yourselves.
verse.verse_36: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_37: When the sky is rent asunder, and becomes red like red leather,
verse.verse_38: which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_39: For, on that Day, neither man nor jinn will be questioned about his sins.
verse.verse_40: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_41: The guilty shall be recognized by their marks so they shall be seized by their forelocks and their feet.
verse.verse_42: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_43: This is the Hell which the guilty called a lie.
verse.verse_44: They will go round between its flames and boiling water.
verse.verse_45: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_46: There are two gardens for one who fears standing before his Lord.
verse.verse_47: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_48: [There will be two gardens with] spreading branches.
verse.verse_49: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_50: In both of them, there are two springs flowing.
verse.verse_51: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_52: In both of them, there will be two kinds of every fruit.
verse.verse_53: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_54: They will recline upon carpets lined with rich brocade; and the fruits of both these gardens will be within easy reach.
verse.verse_55: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_56: Therein are maidens of modest gaze, whom neither a man nor a jinn had ever touched before them.
verse.verse_57: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_58: [There will be] maidens as fair as corals and rubies.
verse.verse_59: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_60: The reward of goodness shall be nothing but goodness.
verse.verse_61: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_62: Besides those two there shall be two other gardens.
verse.verse_63: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_65: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_66: In both of them live springs gush forth.
verse.verse_67: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_68: In both of them there will be fruit trees and date-palms and pomegranates.
verse.verse_69: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_70: Therein will be maidens chaste and beautiful.
verse.verse_71: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_72: [There the blessed will live with their] pure companions sheltered in pavilions.
verse.verse_73: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_74: Whom neither a man or jinn had ever touched before them.
verse.verse_75: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_76: [They will live in such a paradise] reclining upon green cushions and the finest carpets.
verse.verse_77: Which of your Lord's wonders would you deny?
verse.verse_78: Blessed be your Lord's name, full of glory and majesty!
